entry_point.code: static int get_object(struct ref_array_item *ref, int deref,

preconditions: a ref whose object is missing (repo corruption, partial/promisor clone, interrupted fetch, or crafted ref)
processed after a ref whose content was read and freed (e.g. an annotated tag) in the same ref-filter run
a content-reading format atom such as %(*objectname)

evidence.vulnerable_version: git through v2.56.1 (latest release; regression from a29e2e8fe, 2025-10-23)
evidence.observed_result: The faithful get_object() port reproduces glibc 'free(): double free detected in tcache 2' / Aborted (exit 134) on the missing-object-after-tag sequence; the one-line fix (oi->content = NULL) makes it survive (exit 0).

real_exploit.target: git/git ref-filter.c get_object() double free of reused expand_data->content
real_exploit.backend: verbatim-control-flow C port of git v2.56.1 get_object() built with zig cc (glibc), real double-free detector
real_exploit.demonstrated: git for-each-ref --format='%(*objectname)' over an annotated tag followed by a ref with a missing object double-frees oi->content and aborts the git process
